Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

UI-A through UI-H, CR2/CR3/CR6 and interactive bounds are landed. The core-readiness definition requires six contracts for every family, not merely availability of a numerical function. CR4 still carries template/decomposition, point/epoch and scanpath-family gaps; the AOI visit policy is an unresolved owner decision. Studio can use the study family while those remain open. Source recovery and local gates are documented, but no new percentage-of-eyesim or release claim is made.
